prompt: Solveig loves horses and often says, "I wish I (to own) one."
explanation_ru: Для мечты о другой реальности в настоящем после wish используется Past Simple: owned.

prompt: A stranger keeps taking my space in the car park, and I wish he (to stop).
explanation_ru: Для выражения раздражения и желания, чтобы другой человек прекратил что-то делать, после wish ставится would + инфинитив.

prompt: The delivery van shakes our fence on this narrow lane; I wish the driver ___ the main road instead.
options: uses
will use
would use
has used
explanation_ru: Для недовольства чужим поведением и желания его изменить после wish нужно would + инфинитив; настоящее время (uses) и will здесь ошибочны.

prompt: My remote died mid-film; I wish I (to buy) new batteries earlier.
explanation_ru: Сожаление о том, что не было сделано в прошлом, передаётся через wish + Past Perfect: had bought.

prompt: Jing runs a tiny café and wishes she had a small garden next door.
options: Jing has a small garden next to her café.
Jing does not have a garden next to her café.
Jing sold her garden next to the café.
Jing is planting a garden next to her café.
explanation_ru: Конструкция wish + Past Simple (had) означает нереальное желание в настоящем: сейчас сада рядом с кафе нет.

prompt: Alba is tired of the group chat and wishes her friends stop sending silly jokes.
answer: Alba is tired of the group chat and wishes her friends would stop sending silly jokes.
accepted_answers: Alba is tired of the group chat and wishes her friends would stop sending silly jokes.
explanation_ru: После wish нельзя употреблять настоящее время (stop); для раздражения чужими действиями нужно would stop.

prompt: Emil is still sitting in the clinic waiting room. "If only they (to have) more doctors on duty," he texts his sister. "I also wish I (to bring) a book with me. Most of all, I wish the desk (to stop) saying it will take five minutes."
explanation_ru: If only + Past Simple (had) выражает сожаление о текущем положении, wish + Past Perfect (had brought) — о прошлом, а wish + would (would stop) — раздражение.

prompt: Putu walked all the way to the ruined temple to see its painted walls, only to find the gate locked, and now he wishes he (to check) the opening times first.
explanation_ru: Герой жалеет о несовершённом действии в прошлом (не проверил часы работы перед поездкой), поэтому после wish требуется Past Perfect.

prompt: Gergana is not in a warm hotel by the sea. → Gergana wishes she …
answer: Gergana wishes she were in a warm hotel by the sea.
accepted_answers: Gergana wishes she were in a warm hotel by the sea.
Gergana wishes she was in a warm hotel by the sea.
explanation_ru: Для сожаления о настоящем состоянии после wish используется Past Simple: were (в разговорной речи допустимо и was).

prompt: My bakery shifts change all the time; I wish I ___ my hours earlier.
options: know
knew
would know
will know
explanation_ru: Глагол состояния know после wish стоит в Past Simple (knew); would know — частая ошибка русскоязычных учащихся.

prompt: Milena loves drawing in the quiet gallery. She is still a student, and she truly wants her work to hang on that wall in the future.
options: Milena hopes her drawings will hang on that wall one day.
Milena wishes her drawings hung on that wall next year.
Milena hopes her drawings hung on that wall one day.
Milena wishes her drawings hang on that wall one day.
explanation_ru: Реальную надежду на будущее передаёт глагол hope с будущим или настоящим временем, а не wish + Past Simple или hope + Past Simple.

prompt: Roberto and his classmates are shivering at the school bus stop; if only the main gate (to be) open before eight.
explanation_ru: Для сожаления о текущей ситуации после if only используется Past Simple: форма were (или разговорный вариант was).

prompt: If only Jessica's little bookshop had enough room for soft chairs and a tea corner.
options: Jessica's bookshop is large enough for soft chairs and a tea corner.
Jessica removed the soft chairs and tea corner from her bookshop.
Jessica plans to add soft chairs and a tea corner soon.
Jessica's bookshop is too small for soft chairs and a tea corner.
explanation_ru: If only + Past Simple (had) говорит о том, чего не хватает в настоящем: сейчас в книжном магазине слишком мало места.

prompt: Daiki's volleyball team plays in a cold gym all winter. "Our hands feel stiff on the ball," Daiki says before training. "I wish the sports centre (to turn) the heating up before we arrive. I also wish we (not / to book) this hall all season. Do you ever wish we (to have) a warmer hall?"
explanation_ru: Желание изменить действия центра передаётся через would turn (или Past Simple), сожаление о прошлом решении — через had not booked, а мечта о другом зале сейчас — через had.

prompt: I wish my laptop doesn't restart right before my morning call.
answer: I wish my laptop wouldn't restart right before my morning call.
accepted_answers: I wish my laptop wouldn't restart right before my morning call.
I wish my laptop would not restart right before my morning call.
I wish my laptop didn't restart right before my morning call.
I wish my laptop did not restart right before my morning call.
explanation_ru: После wish нельзя ставить настоящее время (doesn't restart); для раздражающей проблемы с техникой нужны wouldn't restart или Past Simple (didn't restart).

prompt: "Another red light in the pouring rain!" Seamus sighs. "Don't you wish the lights (to be) green all the way?"
explanation_ru: После wish для воображаемой ситуации в настоящем используется Past Simple: с подлежащим во множественном числе (the lights) ставится were.

prompt: Asuka missed the last bus at the station and wishes she had left the hostel ten minutes earlier.
options: Asuka did not leave the hostel early enough and missed the bus.
Asuka left the hostel early and caught the last bus.
Asuka plans to leave the hostel ten minutes earlier tomorrow.
Asuka left the hostel ten minutes earlier, yet still missed the bus.
explanation_ru: Wish + Past Perfect (had left) выражает сожаление о прошлом: Асука вышла позже, чем нужно, и опоздала на автобус.

prompt: Pamela is upset that the student hall is not quiet during exam week. → If only the student hall …
answer: If only the student hall were quiet during exam week.
accepted_answers: If only the student hall were quiet during exam week.
If only the student hall was quiet during exam week.
explanation_ru: Сожаление о текущей ситуации передаётся через if only + Past Simple: were (или was) quiet.

prompt: Ola stares at the grey rain and wishes she (to live) by the sea.
explanation_ru: Для мечты о настоящем, отличающемся от реальности, после wish ставится Past Simple: lived.

prompt: Join each half to complete Amelia's thoughts during a long office meeting.
pairs: short emails instead of holding long meetings.
my notebook to this morning's meeting.
I wish the manager would stop
explanation_ru: Wish + Past Simple описывает другую реальность сейчас, wish + Past Perfect — сожаление о прошлом, wish + would — раздражение, а hope + will — реальную надежду.

prompt: Our soup was cold; I wish we ___ to another café.
options: went
would go
have gone
had gone
explanation_ru: Речь о сожалении по поводу уже совершённого выбора в прошлом, поэтому после wish нужен Past Perfect: had gone.

prompt: Laura left a blunt review after waiting an hour past her appointment time. "I wish the reception staff (to warn) me about the delay when I walked in," she wrote. "If only I (not / to move) my afternoon plans only to sit in that hall. I honestly wish they (not / to promise) five more minutes when they know the wait is much longer." She still hopes they will fix their booking system soon.
explanation_ru: Первые два пропуска выражают сожаление о прошлых событиях (Past Perfect), а третий — недовольство привычкой персонала (would not promise или Past Simple).

prompt: The lights flicker as Varun writes his camp notes; he wishes the old generator (not / to fail) mid-sentence.
explanation_ru: Для раздражения из-за повторяющейся поломки после wish используется would not fail (также допустим Past Simple: didn't fail).

prompt: Jelena had to queue for a new hotel key card three times; she wishes she would have booked a different hotel.
answer: Jelena had to queue for a new hotel key card three times; she wishes she had booked a different hotel.
accepted_answers: Jelena had to queue for a new hotel key card three times; she wishes she had booked a different hotel.
Jelena had to queue for a new hotel key card three times; she wishes she'd booked a different hotel.
explanation_ru: Для сожаления о прошлом действии после wish нужен Past Perfect (had booked), а не would have booked — это типичная ошибка-калька с русского.

prompt: After a third long shift, I wish I worked in a quiet place without phones.
options: The speaker works in a quiet place with no phones.
The speaker used to work in a quiet place before.
The speaker works in a noisy place with ringing phones.
The speaker is moving to a quiet office next month.
explanation_ru: Wish + Past Simple (worked) отражает противоположную реальность в настоящем: сейчас говорящий работает в шумном месте с постоянными звонками.

prompt: The coffee machine broke right before Caoimhe's turn, so she regrets waiting for twenty minutes at the museum café. → Caoimhe wishes she …
answer: Caoimhe wishes she had not waited for twenty minutes at the museum café.
accepted_answers: Caoimhe wishes she had not waited for twenty minutes at the museum café.
Caoimhe wishes she hadn't waited for twenty minutes at the museum café.
Caoimhe wishes she had not waited twenty minutes at the museum café.
Caoimhe wishes she hadn't waited twenty minutes at the museum café.
explanation_ru: Сожаление о том, что уже произошло в прошлом, передаётся конструкцией wish + Past Perfect в отрицательной форме (had not waited).

prompt: Goran looks outside and wishes the maths lesson (not / to last) so long.
explanation_ru: Для желания изменить текущее положение дел после wish используется Past Simple: didn't last.

prompt: The parcel from the online shop arrived in the wrong colour, and they still charged me for delivery. I wish I (to read) the reviews before paying. If only they (to offer) free returns like other shops do. Honestly, I wish customer support (to answer) my emails instead of sending automatic replies.
explanation_ru: Сожаление о прошлом действии требует Past Perfect (had read), о текущих условиях магазина — Past Simple (offered), а недовольство работой поддержки — would answer.

prompt: Coach's note: Our outdoor basketball court has had a bent rim for weeks, and we have to move indoors; if only the council ___ it before the season began.
options: had repaired
repaired
would repair
has repaired
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о сожалении о прошлом (кольцо не починили до начала сезона), поэтому после if only нужен Past Perfect: had repaired.

prompt: Whenever my manager starts speaking on a video call, the app freezes; I wish the developers would release a proper update soon.
answer: Whenever my manager starts speaking on a video call, the app freezes; I wish the developers would release a proper update soon.
accepted_answers: Whenever my manager starts speaking on a video call, the app freezes; I wish the developers would release a proper update soon.
explanation_ru: Ошибки здесь нет: для пожелания, чтобы кто-то другой наконец изменил раздражающую ситуацию, после wish верно стоит would + инфинитив (would release).

prompt: The student hall Wi-Fi cuts out during Anders's online lecture again; he wishes he ___ the presenter clearly.
options: can hear
would hear
could hear
will hear
explanation_ru: Чтобы выразить сожаление о невозможности что-то сделать в данный момент, после wish ставится could + инфинитив, а не can, will или would.

prompt: Jisoo walks her dog by the lake and gets annoyed because the park bins overflow by noon and rubbish blows across the grass. Which sentence expresses her complaint correctly?
options: Jisoo wishes the park staff empty the bins more often.
Jisoo wishes the park staff would empty the bins more often.
Jisoo wishes the park staff will empty the bins more often.
Jisoo hopes the park staff had emptied the bins more often.
explanation_ru: Жалоба и желание изменить действия других людей передаются через wish + would + инфинитив; настоящее время, will и hope + Past Perfect здесь неверны.

prompt: Sitting behind a pile of unread folders at half past four, Adaeze wishes she could leave with a clear desk at five.
options: Adaeze can easily clear her desk and leave at five.
Adaeze will not be able to finish her work and leave a tidy desk by five.
Adaeze left her desk tidy at five yesterday.
Adaeze did not have any folders on her desk at half past four.
explanation_ru: Wish + could (could leave) показывает, что желаемое сейчас недостижимо: Адаэзе не успеет разобрать все бумаги к пяти часам.

prompt: Match each sentence about Rashid's rooftop café dream with what is actually true.
pairs: Rashid wishes he had enough savings
He does not have the money at present.
If only Rashid could rent that rooftop
He is unable to get that space.
Rashid wishes the city would change its closing rules
The council keeps forcing cafés to shut early.
If only Rashid had bought the flat five years ago
He missed his chance in the past.
explanation_ru: Past Simple после wish/if only говорит о нехватке чего-то сейчас, could — о невозможности, would — о раздражающих правилах, а Past Perfect — об упущенной возможности в прошлом.

prompt: Aiko has to cook for everyone on her birthday, and she dislikes that. → Aiko wishes she …
answer: Aiko wishes she did not have to cook for everyone on her birthday.
accepted_answers: Aiko wishes she did not have to cook for everyone on her birthday.
Aiko wishes she didn't have to cook for everyone on her birthday.
explanation_ru: Для сожаления о текущей обязанности глагол have to после wish переходит в отрицательную форму Past Simple: did not have to.

prompt: Lying back in the dentist's chair, I close my eyes and picture a sunny beach instead. "I wish I (to lie) on warm sand right now," I tell myself silently. "If only I (not / to skip) my check-ups last year, this visit would be over in five minutes. Honestly, I wish I (not / to mind) coming to the dentist so much."
explanation_ru: Воображаемое действие в момент речи передаётся через Past Continuous (were lying), сожаление о прошлом — через Past Perfect (had not skipped), а о своём постоянном отношении сейчас — через Past Simple (did not mind).
